svg.title: Two comparisons by the rules-v4 matcher
svg.desc: The black reference listing compared with two others. Against a reworded marketplace listing of the same product: model 0.92, title 0.62, brand 0.90, attributes 1.00, category 1.00, no GTIN on both sides; identifier agreement gives AUTO_MATCH with score 0.90. Against the silver reference listing: model 1.00, title 0.78, brand 1.00, but GTIN 0.00 and attributes 0.00; GTIN_CONFLICT and VARIANT_CONFLICT (black vs silver) give NO_MATCH with score 0.45.
